# sapintegrationsuite_access_policy (Data Source)

Looks up an existing access policy by its numeric ID or by role name. The role name lookup is the portable choice: the same policy has a different ID in every tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look the policy up by role name: the numeric ID differs in every tenant,
# the role name does not.
data "sapintegrationsuite_access_policy" "utilities" {
  role_name = "UTILITIES_ARCHITECT"
}

# Attach an extra rule to a policy that another team's configuration owns.
resource "sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference" "billing_flow" {
  access_policy_id = data.sapintegrationsuite_access_policy.utilities.id

  name          = "Billing flow"
  artifact_type = "INTEGRATION_FLOW"
  attribute     = "Name"
  operator      = "exactString"
  value         = "Billing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the policy. Set exactly one of id or role_name.
- `role_name` (String) Role name of the policy, unique per tenant. Set exactly one of id or role_name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The policy's description, or null when it has none.
